user.title: Configuration method
user.description: Configure all NTP servers together. Only one instance of this integration can be added.

settings.title: NTP monitoring settings
settings.description: Dispersion thresholds are in seconds, not milliseconds. Warning thresholds must be lower than critical thresholds.

data_description.servers: One hostname or IP address per line. Do not include URLs, paths, or port numbers. Server names are trimmed and converted to lowercase; duplicates are not allowed.
data_description.scan_interval: Whole seconds between polls, at least 10.
data_description.timeout: Seconds to wait for each server, from 0.1 to 30.
data_description.warning_dispersion: Warn when root dispersion reaches this value, in seconds. Must be at least 0 and below the critical value.
data_description.critical_dispersion: Report critical when root dispersion reaches this value, in seconds. Must be above the warning value.
data_description.warning_stratum: Warn when the server stratum exceeds this integer, from 1 to 15. Must be below the critical threshold.
data_description.critical_stratum: Report critical when the server stratum exceeds this integer, from 1 to 15. Must be above the warning threshold.

import_config.title: Import JSON configuration
import_config.description: Paste a complete NTP Server Health JSON export (format ntp_server_health, version 1). All seven settings are required. Invalid JSON or settings will not be saved.

data_description.configuration: Paste the entire document, including format, version, and settings.

error.invalid_settings: Settings must be a JSON object.
error.unknown_settings: Unknown settings are not allowed. Use only the seven documented settings.
error.missing_settings: The imported settings must include all seven settings, including the server list.
error.invalid_servers: Enter at least one valid hostname or IP address. Do not include blank entries, URLs, paths, port numbers, or whitespace inside a host.
error.duplicate_servers: Each server must be unique after trimming whitespace and converting to lowercase.
error.invalid_number: Enter finite numbers, not booleans or text. Polling interval and stratum thresholds must be whole numbers.
error.out_of_range: Use a polling interval of at least 10 seconds, a timeout from 0.1 to 30 seconds, nonnegative dispersion thresholds, and stratum thresholds from 1 to 15.
error.dispersion_order: The warning dispersion must be strictly below the critical dispersion.
error.stratum_order: The warning stratum must be strictly below the critical stratum.
error.invalid_json: Paste valid JSON without duplicate object keys.
error.invalid_format: The JSON must contain exactly format, version, and settings, with format set to ntp_server_health.
error.unsupported_version: Only JSON configuration version 1 is supported.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one NTP Server Health instance is allowed. Use Configure on the existing integration to change its settings or import JSON.
abort.already_configured: NTP Server Health is already configured. Use Configure on the existing integration.

init.title: Manage NTP configuration
init.description: Edit settings or replace them with an imported JSON document. Export only displays the current configuration and does not save changes or reload the integration.
